g.data-description: Tables 8 and 9 - Link green steady when the port and link are active; Activity green blinking with activity
g.title: mgmt

g.data-description: Table 5 - MGT: green steady, Junos OS loaded; green blinking, booting; unlit, powered off or halted
g.title: led-mgt

g.data-description: Table 5 - FAN: green steady, the fans are working; amber blinking, at least one fan has failed; unlit, no alarm or powered off
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: Table 5 - PW: green steady, the power supply is working; amber blinking, PoE power to the ports is disabled; unlit, powered off
g.title: led-pw
